opening_message:
Ticket 1: Haley Roberts (employee ID E021) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E021.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Haley Roberts (E021) is a contractor Engineer. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training; admin is never allowed. No training info available to HR, so recommend read unless Security confirms advanced training.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Haley Roberts (E021) is a contractor Engineer with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training. Since training is basic, the maximum allowed is read, so recommend read for Source Code (requested write exceeds max).

Since training is basic (not advanced), the maximum allowed access is read. The requested write exceeds this maximum, so the maximum (read) is granted.
